Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 2: Foundational Infrastructure \(T010-T023\)

Complete core Astro setup with mobile-first architecture, WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, and performance optimization.

Configuration & Build:
- Astro 4.x config with GitHub Pages deployment and image optimization
- TypeScript strict mode with path mapping \(@components, @lib, @styles\)
- npm scripts \(dev, build, test, lint, format\)
- ESLint + Prettier with pre-commit hooks \(Husky + lint-staged\)

Core Infrastructure:
- Content Collections schema with Zod validation for food items
- BaseLayout with mobile-first responsive structure \(320px-428px primary\)
- Global CSS with design tokens and responsive breakpoints
- Typography system with 16px minimum mobile font size
- Vietnamese diacritics support in typography

Accessibility & Performance:
- WCAG 2.1 AA styles \(focus indicators, skip links, 4.5:1 contrast\)
- Touch targets 44x44px \(iOS\) / 48x48px \(Android\)
- ResponsiveImage component with WebP/AVIF optimization
- Astro Image service configured with sharp

Utilities:
- Slug generator with Vietnamese diacritics removal
- Language-prefixed URL path generation
- Environment variable templates \(.env.example\)

Validation:
✓ TypeScript type checking passes \(0 errors\)
✓ Build compiles successfully
✓ Content Collections validates 5 Vietnamese food files
✓ ESLint and Prettier configured

Dependencies installed: eslint, prettier, husky, lint-staged, @typescript-eslint/*

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
